title: COMPETENCY / CAPABILITY LEADER
description:
Purpose

Build world-class Data, Analytics and AI capability through offerings, reusable assets, architecture standards and industry solutions.

Role Overview

The Competency / Capability Leader runs the practices engine room — the offering factory, the reusable IP portfolio, architecture governance and the talent certification agenda. This leader ensures that every pursuit and delivery engagement is powered by hardened, healthcare-specific assets rather than one-off effort, and that the practice's technical standards keep pace with the Data-for-AI market. The role also anchors platform partnerships and provides senior technical firepower on large pursuits.

Key Responsibilities

•Own the offering factory — from concept through packaging, enablement and field adoption.

•Run the asset-harvesting engine — systematically mine delivery engagements for reusable IP, accelerators and solution patterns.

•Manage architecture governance and technical standards across the practice.

•Build accelerators and reusable IP that raise win rates and delivery productivity.

•Define AI-SDLC estimation models and productivity benchmarks used in pursuits and delivery planning.

•Drive certifications and structured capability development across the talent base.

•Lead platform partner collaboration (Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, AWS, GCP) — joint solution development and co-sell assets.

•Support large pursuits with differentiated solution constructs and assets.

Data-for-AI Skills

Must Have: Data Platform Architecture · AI Platform Architecture · Lakehouse Architecture · Data

Mesh · Data Products · MLOps · GenAI Architecture · Data Governance

Nice to Have: Agentic AI · Graph Databases · GraphRAG · Digital Twins · Healthcare Ontologies · AI

Foundry · Databricks Mosaic AI

Understanding of Healthcare Data, Standards & Compliance

Expected depth: Deep technical mastery — the standards and compliance knowledge must be encoded into offerings, reference architectures and reusable assets.

Healthcare Data Sets: Claims (medical & pharmacy) · Clinical / EHR (Epic Clarity/Caboodle, Cerner Millennium) · Enrollment / eligibility · Labs & imaging · Provider / member MDM domains · Registries & HIE feeds · Device telemetry · SDOH & RWD · OMOP CDM research data

Standards & Terminologies

FHIR R4 / US Core · Bulk FHIR · HL7 v2 / v3 / CDA & C-CDA · X12 EDI · NCPDP · DICOM · SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10, CPT / HCPCS terminology services · USCDI · TEFCA · OMOP CDM

Compliance & Regulatory

HIPAA de-identification engineering (Safe Harbor / Expert Determination) · Consent management patterns · 42 CFR Part 2 (behavioral health) · CMS interoperability rules (0057-F, 9115-F) · ONC certification criteria · FDA 21 CFR Part 11 / SaMD data considerations (HMT) · Policy-as-code governance

Guild & Community Contributions

•Define reference architectures

•Lead review boards

•Publish solution standards

AI Guild

•Publish AI blueprints

•Create AI accelerators

•Build enterprise AI frameworks

Industry Offerings Guild

•Establish reusable frameworks
